name: Rumbling Gait
description: Walk with a low rumble in the ground that gathers heat under every pace.

name: Venting Fist
description: Strike with a fist that vents a jet of hot qi into the target on contact.

name: Pressure Guard
description: Hold the body tight with pent heat that pushes outward against any blow struck on it.

name: Swelling Heat
description: Swell the ground under the foe with rising heat and throw them off their feet.

name: Gouting Spire
description: Spout a narrow spire of molten stone from the ground beneath the target.

name: Ashfall Cloak
description: Draw a cloak of falling hot ash about the body that chokes and scorches nearby foes.

name: Rising Outburst
description: Gather heat beneath the field for several breaths then burst it upward in a wide fountain.

name: Hammering Flow
description: Bring a molten fist down in a heavy overhead blow that spreads liquid stone on impact.

name: Great Eruption
description: Break open the ground in a roaring eruption that hurls molten stone and fire over a vast front.

name: Channel Step
description: Step along a thin channel of molten qi that carries the foot smoothly forward.

name: Streaming Palm
description: Send a palm streaming forward in a burning wash of qi that coats the target.

name: Embanked Heat
description: Bank heat in raised walls of qi at the sides of the body to keep blows from the flanks.

name: Rivulet Sense
description: Feel the course of every hot current in the field and the shape of the ground it follows.

name: Channeling Flow
description: Channel the burning river round the foe so that they are hemmed into a ring of heat.

name: Overrunning Lava
description: Pour lava over the ground in a sheet that sweeps foes along and burns their legs.

name: Meander Strike
description: Curve a strike round the foe's guard along a bend of the river and land it behind.

name: Burning Torrent
description: Open the river in a surge of burning torrent that tears across the field and buries all in its path.

name: Floodgate Seal
description: Dam the foe's qi with a barrier of cooled flow so their techniques pile up unreleased.

name: Molten Torrent
description: Pour a glowing river across the whole field that burns what it crosses and slowly bends to the user's will.

name: Vitreous Step
description: Slide across a skin of dark glass laid under the foot and leave it cracking behind.

name: Keen Knuckle
description: Strike with a knuckle edged by glassy qi that cuts as it lands.

name: Black Pauldron
description: Form a black glassy plate over the shoulder to take a downward blow.

name: Glassy Gaze
description: Look through a lens of black glass to see the heat and the qi in a foe's frame.

name: Flaking Edge
description: Flake glassy edges off the forearm and fling them at the foe's face.

name: Crown Spikes
description: Raise spikes of black glass about the head and shoulders to guard and to gore any who close.

name: Razor Cascade
description: Spill a cascade of razor shards in an arc from the shoulders across everything near.

name: Onyx Mirror
description: Present a polished black face to a bolt and throw it back along the line it came.

name: Obsidian Regalia
description: Wear a full harness of obsidian that turns blows and cuts every hand and weapon that touches it.

name: Shattering Verdict
description: Burst the whole harness outward at once into a hail of black shards.

name: Crown of Glass
description: Raise a crown of black glass that guards the user wholly and then bursts to flay the field.

name: Bluefire Step
description: Move in a flicker of blue heat that leaves a pale afterimage where the body had been.

name: Sapphire Palm
description: Strike with a palm burning blue and white that sears deeper than red heat can.

name: Pale Shield
description: Set up a shield of pale intense heat that blisters hands before they reach it.

name: Whitehot Lance
description: Thrust a lance of white heat through the guard and into the body behind.

name: Azure Smelt
description: Hold a blue flame near the foe's qi centre until their strength begins to run thin.

name: Searing Tide
description: Sweep a tide of blue-white heat across the ground before the user.

name: Lancing Storm
description: Gather heat for several breaths then loose a storm of molten lances at the foes.

name: Blue Core
description: Hold a blue-hot core of qi at the centre of the body and strike any who come within reach.

name: Heart of Sapphire
description: Drive the blue core into one point of the foe and burn through all that stands between it and the heart.

name: Bellowed Step
description: Take a step fanned by a gust from behind so the hot body surges forward.

name: Fanned Fist
description: Strike with a fist whose heat flares white as the wind fans it on contact.

name: Scorching Draft
description: Stir a hot draft before the arm that thrusts a blow wide on a wall of heat.

name: Updraft Sense
description: Feel how the wind carries heat through the field and where it will meet the foe.

name: Wind Cinder
description: Fling burning cinders on a gust so they sting from several sides.

name: Roaring Flow
description: Drive a flow of lava forward on a roaring wind that scorches the whole front.

name: Whipped Embers
description: Whip glowing embers into the foe's eyes and guard to spoil their next move.

name: Draft Furnace
description: Wrap the body in a roaring updraft of heat that scorches all foes who press near.

name: Fire Tornado
description: Spin a column of lava and wind round the foes and hold them in its slow turning.

name: Gale Furnace
description: Gather wind and molten qi into a furnace of roaring air and loose it over the front.

name: Lavastorm Lash
description: Lash out with a rope of wind-fed lava that cuts through the guard and scatters the stance.

name: Windfed Cataclysm
description: Feed the molten field with the full gale and unleash a cataclysm of fire and lava on the front.

name: Oathcool Pace
description: Pace out a sworn line of cooling stone qi and hold the body to it.

name: Oathstone Fist
description: Swear the fist to stone at the instant of the strike so it lands with all the weight of rock.

name: Setting Guard
description: Let the molten guard set hard as the blow arrives and hold its sworn shape.

name: Chilling Vow
description: Speak a vow of cooling over the foe and watch molten qi round them harden into a hold.

name: Frozen Flow
description: Cool the foe's own flowing qi to a standstill so that their techniques stall.

name: Sudden Setting
description: Strike a soft limb then cool the heat inside it so the limb sets stiff.

name: Sworn Cooling
description: Pour molten stone over a wide front then cool it on a sworn count to lock the foes in place.

name: Stonebound Form
description: Cool the whole body into sworn stone that no blow may move for as long as the oath is kept.

name: Oath in Stone
description: Cool a whole field of lava on the instant sworn and entomb all within it in dark rock.

name: Stone Climb
description: Climb a wall of cooled stone qi in two steps and pivot over its top.

name: Battering Elbow
description: Batter the foe with an elbow weighted like a block of basalt.

name: Basalt Slab
description: Raise a slab of dark stone from the ground before the user to take a blow.

name: Tall Barrier
description: Lift a tall barrier of cooled stone and hold it up while heat builds behind.

name: Pressing Slab
description: Push a wall forward on a cushion of heat so foes must give ground or be crushed.

name: Burst Slab
description: Burst the wall from behind in a spray of hot stone and molten fragments.

name: Layered Barrier
description: Raise three thin walls in quick succession so that each one takes part of the force.

name: Slab Fall
description: Topple a great wall onto the foe in a single crushing fall with molten edges.

name: Pent Fury
description: Let the heat pent behind the wall burst through it in a roaring wave across the field.

name: Basalt Mantle
description: Hold a towering rampart of basalt that no force can pass and whose heat bears down on all foes near.

name: Smolder Step
description: Walk in a trail of faint smoulder that clings to the heels of the foes behind.

name: Glowing Palm
description: Plant a glowing palm that leaves a slow smoulder in the target.

name: Smoke Screen
description: Pour a screen of hot smoke before the body that blocks sight and stings the lungs.

name: Ember Count
description: Count the smouldering marks laid upon foes and feel how near each is to flaring.

name: Slow Brand
description: Lay a faint brand on a foe that glows for a long while and wears at their focus.

name: Spreading Smoulder
description: Spread a low smoulder across a group so that each takes a little burn each breath.

name: Sapping Heat
description: Let the smoulder sap the strength of every branded foe until their blows come slack.

name: Flare Marks
description: Flare all the marks at once so that each branded foe bursts in a spot of heat.

name: Unrelenting Burn
description: Keep a heavy smoulder on a whole body of foes so that none can rest or take a clean breath.

name: Brandfall
description: Call down a rain of glowing brands on all marked foes so each is struck in the same breath.

name: Host Ablaze
description: Set a whole host ablaze with a slow white heat that spreads through every marked body and cannot be put out.
